Information Shareholder Information Order Documents Q1. When was the Company established? A1. The Company was originally founded as Matsushita Electric Devices Manufacturing Works in 1918. In 1935, the Company was incorporated as Matsushita Electric Industrial Co., Ltd. In 2008, the Company changed its name to Panasonic Corporation. In 2022, the Company changed its name to Panasonic Holdings Corporation, after the transition to a new organizational system in which the former Panasonic is a holding company. Q2. I would like to know the number of Panasonic Group Companies and Employees. A2. For quarter ends, please see IR Summary . Please see Corporate Governance - Panasonic Holdings . Q6. Where can I find information about the Company's risk factors? A6. Please see Risk Factors of Annual Securities Report.
